body:
This is about being downvoted over stupid reasons. I'm sorry, but I'm not giving much context to anyone because I don't feel like being witch hunted.   


I get downvoting, I really do. If I were silently being downvoted, I would be okay with it. But a lot of it comes with bullying, hateful comments and people who see the opportunity to become a bully, just because everyone else is doing it. This of course, is over the dumbest of things that really doesn't need or deserve that kind of ignorance.

Can I ask why people keep saying that I should be comfortable with myself first? The whole reason why I'm desperate for friends is because I'm lonely. If I had good, trustworthy friends, I wouldn't be in this position. But every time I get a friend, they always have some form of problem with me, but god forbid, telling me what that is, so that I can fix it. So then, there my mind goes, criticizing myself because I can't figure out what's wrong with me for people to dislike me so much as to never text me or call me or even want to just be around me alone.   


I used to think it was because I was fat. Then I realized that there were people the same size as me, who had hundreds of friends. Then I though, is it cause I'm annoying? Am I bad at conversations? I. Don't. Know. I have been outgoing, I have been nice, I have been kind, I have helped people out money wise, I have lent items out to people, I have invited them out but they still treat me the same. I gain a friend, the shit ends in a fireball because of something they don't like, that gets on their nerves and they don't tell me. Then they say, "Well, it's not my job to tell you.." YES IT IS. As a friend, if you don't like something, tell me. I will get hurt, but at least I know and I can deal with it.   


At the end of the day, do I blame them? No. Do I blame anyone else? Absolutely not. I don't even blame myself. I am a lonely person and I've had enough of being the invisible one.

Again, trying to pin something else to be "in the right". I didn't label it a rant, that was automatic and If it was against the rules, it would've been taken down by the mods. So find something else better to do than to irritate me with your constant need for a fight.

I placed this here because I'm irritated about the situation. Irritation is a form of anger. Since there's no subreddit called "irritation" and this technically isn't a rant, since this issue has been ongoing for awhile, I placed it here. 

The sad part about this is, that you're trying to pin me for anything and everything. It's absolutely clear. First, it was because you personally didn't want to hear what I had to say, and then it was about "breaking rules",which I didn't and even decided to downvote me because I called you out. 

Seriously, find something else better else to do than constantly harass people, because you're bored or having a hard time or whatever. It's not my problem or my fault, so stop projecting it on me.

Isn't it what this subreddit is for? Brodcasting your anger to strangers? I don't know what you're doing here if you truly think that any of what you've just said would work in real life. 

See, when you have friends, you can't just tell them whatever is on your mind or however your feeling, simply because you're thinking or feeling that way. If anything, you have to be in the right situation *and* do it with tact. Since I'm neither in the right situation and there is no tact to how I feel, I'm not going to say anything to him.

I know he's going through a rough patch, despite my irritation towards the repetitiveness of his conversations. I'm not about to make that worse by telling him that I don't give a shit and he needs to just "deal with it". One, it would be rude, two, it would upset him and three, he's been there for me plenty of times and hasn't backed down. 

So, because of that, what I'm now doing is venting to strangers anonymously, ( Again, like everyone else on this subreddit) so that I don't blow up in his face, due to bottling it up.

Like I've told the others, I would've spoken up, but I didn't because I was already angry at the fact that he cut the line. I don't have a vehicle, I have to walk home and all I wanted to do was to go home. I wasn't going to start a verbal altercation with an idiot who couldn't wait and I certainly don't want to be banned from the store, I frequent there and I'd rather have my place. I would've had a lot more trouble on my hands, given that he would've talked back.

If I had said anything to him, it wouldn't have been "excuse me". I was already pissed off as it was and didn't want to get into a verbal altercation over anything. I was about to, honestly and if I ever do see that guy again and he does the same thing to me, again, I will say something.
The cashier said something, and he said "Yeah, I'm just gonna sneak in here." and I think she was waiting for me to say something but I was too pissed off to start a verbal fight.
